text: Ok so the edinburgh weekend. Still keen? Thinking early dec

No idea on the castle. I'd guess most days but check

It says open every day in winter, last entry about 5. Adult ticket around £20 online, probably more on the door

Now, the cheap ones go fast. I'll look tonight

😂 she's really committed to this

[photo: train booking confirmation]
Good. Castle monday, so back sunday then?

Sorry I read it wrong. Monday night's fine
Going to sleep, don't stay up on your phone
Ok. One thing, do you want the castle or are we just walking the royal mile
Doesn't matter to me
